question: An electron is moving with velocity v along positive x-axis in a magnetic field directed along positive y-axis. The Lorentz force on the electron points along:
explanation: F = -e (v × B) = -e (v i × B j) = -e v B (i × j) = -e v B k (directed along negative z-axis). | Hint: Electron has negative charge: -e (i × j) = -k.

question: Two very long, straight, parallel conductors A and B carry current of 5 A and 10 A respectively and are at a distance of 10 cm from each other. The direction of current in two conductors is same. The force acting per unit length between two conductors is : (μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ SI unit)
explanation: F/l = μ₀I₁I₂/(2πd) = 4π×10⁻⁷×5×10/(2π×0.1) = 10⁻⁴ N m⁻¹; currents in the same direction attract.
